after5_farewell_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_low.text: *You run into Seoyeon in the hallway. She pauses, then gives you a single nod.* I know what you decided. I have nothing else to say.

after5_farewell_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_low.text: *Your eyes meet outside the library. Yuna holds her book close and gives you a small nod.* Bye.

after5_farewell_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_low.text: *Dain walks up outside the gym and stops two paces away.* I know what you decided. I'll head inside.

after5_farewell_seo_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_1.text: *I run into Seoyeon in the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_3.text: *She tucks loose hair behind her ear and readjusts her grip on her bag strap.*

after5_farewell_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_4.text: Well, I expected it. I just don't want it to look like I was the one who gave up first.

after5_farewell_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6.text: If that's your decision, I'll respect it. That doesn't mean I've sorted out my own feelings.

after5_farewell_seo_6_b.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_6_b.text: *She turns away and waves. She does not look back. Only the ribbon at her wrist sways at the end of the hallway.*

after5_farewell_seo_7.name: {name}
after5_farewell_seo_7.text: *I'm left alone in the hall. Seoyeon's footsteps fade, and somewhere upstairs, the rooftop door locks.*

after5_farewell_yuna_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_1.text: *Yuna approaches in front of the library. Without a word, she hands me a book.*

after5_farewell_yuna_2.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_2.text: *A bookmark is tucked inside. A single line on the bookmark.*

after5_farewell_yuna_3.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_3.text: Don't be late for the person you chose. ...I still like you, though.

after5_farewell_yuna_4.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_4.text: *She turns down the hall toward the library. The sound of her shoes disappears around the corner.*

after5_farewell_yuna_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_yuna_5.text: *I reread the short line on the bookmark: “I had fun.” The ink blurs beneath the final letter.*

after5_farewell_dain_1.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_1.text: *Dain walks over from the gym. Her steps are shorter than usual.*

after5_farewell_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_2.text: Tch, that stings! But I'm not backing off just because I'm disappointed.

after5_farewell_dain_4.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4.text: I know who you chose. I still like you, though. I'm allowed to say that much.

after5_farewell_dain_4_b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_4_b.text: *Dain gives my shoulder a light punch.*

after5_farewell_dain_4_c.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_c.text: Treat her right. If you don't, I'm winning you back.

after5_farewell_dain_4_d.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_4_d.text: *She pushes the volleyball into the rack and readjusts the strap of her knee brace.*

after5_farewell_dain_5.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5.text: *Dain tightens the strap of her knee brace once more and goes into the gym.*

after5_farewell_dain_5b.name: {name}
after5_farewell_dain_5b.text: *I leave the gym and head toward the back of the school.*

after5_hidden_farewell_1.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_1.text: *At the school gate, Seoyeon checks the event roster with Haeun, Dain shortens her stride with a volleyball under one arm, and Yuna lowers her eyes to an open book. Each heads for a different exit.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3.text: *At the gate, I raise one hand in farewell.*

after5_hidden_farewell_3b.name: {name}
after5_hidden_farewell_3b.text: *I walk toward the back of the school.*

after5_sunset_1.name: {name}
after5_sunset_1.text: *Sunset catches on every classroom window. The broadcast room announces the event's end, and the field speakers crackle a beat behind.*

after5_hidden_route_choice_check.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice_check.text: *The path to meet my friends and the path back to help finish the event split here.*

after5_hidden_route_choice.name: {name}
after5_hidden_route_choice.text: *The road to the park and the road back to help finish the event split here. I have to decide who gets my answer today.*
choices: Go to the park and finish the choice I had already started
Return to the homeroom teacher and organize the literature-club manuscript
Return to the school nurse and organize the counseling records

after5_last_chance_1.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_1.text: *The event speakers power down. Beneath the sign at the fork in the road, I stop, unable to choose a direction.*

after5_last_chance_2.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2.text: *I take the phone from my pocket. Only the event banner is reflected in its black screen.*

after5_last_chance_2_b.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_b.text: *Without turning on the phone, I put it back in my pocket. I take two steps toward the other side of the fork and call her name.*

after5_last_chance_2_d.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_d.text: *Seoyeon turns around. The event banner behind her folds once in the wind.*

after5_last_chance_2_f.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_2_f.text: *Seoyeon winds the end of her student council ribbon around one finger, then lets it go.*

after5_last_chance_2_g.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_2_g.text: I'll talk. Just stay for a minute.

after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_low_2.text: *She looks back, one foot still half pointed toward the exit.* Why?

after5_last_chance_2_l.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_l.text: *She takes one step past me, then presses the volleyball to the floor and stops.*

after5_last_chance_2_n.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_n.text: *The arm holding the ball drops from her side. The toe of her sneaker turns back toward {name}.*

after5_last_chance_2_p.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_p.text: *She bites her lip once and takes a short breath.*

after5_last_chance_2_q.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_q.text: I cannot smile right away. But I will hear what brought you this far.

after5_last_chance_2_r.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_r.text: *She rubs the corner of her eye. Moisture clings to the back of her hand.*

after5_last_chance_2_s.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_2_s.text: Say it. I'll listen to the end.

after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_low_2.text: *She comes back after taking one step too far. Holding the volleyball against her chest, she keeps her distance.* Why?

after5_last_chance_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_2.text: *She stops. She hugs the book to her chest. It takes about two seconds for her to turn around.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_4.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_4.text: *Two steps remain between us. Yuna waits with the book against her chest.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_5.text: I'll listen before I go. Even if I can't say it's okay.

after5_last_chance_yuna_6.name: {name}
after5_last_chance_yuna_6.text: *Yuna doesn't look away. The distance between us has narrowed by one step.*

after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_low_2.text: *She looks back between the shelves, her arms tightening around the book.* Why?

after5_last_chance_choice.name: {name}
choices: Let us both take some time to think.

after5_confess_yes.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes.text: *I put the phone in my pocket and call her name.*

after5_confess_yes_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_yes_2.text: I like you. As more than a friend. I know I am late, but I wanted to tell you myself.

after5_confess_react_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo.text: *We start walking toward the park.* You took your time. But… now I know how you feel.

after5_confess_react_seo_low.name: Seoyeon
after5_confess_react_seo_low.text: *She says nothing until the crosswalk signal changes once.* I heard you. That's enough for now.

after5_confess_react_dain.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain.text: *She looks down at her shoelaces as we leave.* Hey. I was waiting to hear that. No pretending you never said it, okay?

after5_confess_react_dain_low.name: Dain
after5_confess_react_dain_low.text: *Her thumb traces a groove in the volleyball.* I heard you. But I can't smile right away yet.

after5_confess_react_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna.text: *We walk side by side.* Yes. I heard what you said.

after5_confess_react_yuna_b.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_b.text: *She sets the book down, then grips the corner again.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_c.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_c.text: I still wanted to hear you say it.

after5_confess_react_yuna_d.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_d.text: *She hands me a folded note. When I unfold it, there is a single line.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_f.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_f.text: *One letter is pressed hard into the page. The paper bears the creases of being folded and unfolded over and over.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_g.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_g.text: If you read it, that's enough.

after5_confess_react_yuna_h.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_h.text: *We walked side by side. In silence.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_i.name: {name}
after5_confess_react_yuna_i.text: *We step out through the school gate.*

after5_confess_react_yuna_low.name: Yuna
after5_confess_react_yuna_low.text: *She folds the note in her hand.* I read it. But I still can't decide on the ending.

after5_confess_fail_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_1.text: *The sun sinks lower. We just keep walking the same way.*

after5_confess_fail_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_fail_walk_2.text: *Without reaching an answer, we walk toward the park.*

after5_confess_no.name: {name}
after5_confess_no.text: *I turn off the phone screen and press my lips together.*

after5_confess_no_2.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2.text: *The evening breeze rolls an event flyer to my feet. I pick it up and tuck it beneath the bulletin board.*

after5_confess_no_2b.name: {name}
after5_confess_no_2b.text: *In the end, I turn around and head home.*

after5_set_harem.name: {name}
after5_set_harem.text: *The words I folded away at lunch remain. Three message threads light up at once, and I can't type the first letter in any of them.*

after5_harem_commit.name: {name}
after5_harem_commit.text: *After switching among all three chats, I lower the phone. “I couldn't choose one person.” Their eyes lift from their screens to {name}.*

after5_harem_walk_1.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_1.text: *Nobody speaks first all the way to the back of the school.*

after5_harem_walk_2.name: {name}
after5_harem_walk_2.text: *Unanswered messages remain on my lock screen. My feet turn toward the park.*

after5_defer_seo.name: Seoyeon
after5_defer_seo.text: *She slowly lowers her open hand.* Fine. If that is what you decided.

after5_defer_dain.name: Dain
after5_defer_dain.text: *She hugs the volleyball again.* Okay. We are stopping here again today.

after5_defer_yuna.name: Yuna
after5_defer_yuna.text: *She gathers the book back to her chest.* I see. We are stopping here again today.

after5_co_start.name: {name}
after5_co_start.text: *The event winds down. The faces left in the hallway are the same ones from this morning.*

after5_co_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_seo_1.text: *She starts to adjust her glasses, then lowers her hand.* I already handed out the schedule.

after5_co_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_seo_2.text: I have nothing more to say today. Go.

after5_co_yuna_1.name: Yuna
after5_co_yuna_1.text: *She puts the bookmark in her bag.* I left the board empty.

after5_co_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_co_yuna_2.text: Do not follow me. Not today.

after5_co_dain_1.name: Dain
after5_co_dain_1.text: *She shoves the ball into the bin.* I took your name off the partner list.

after5_co_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_co_dain_2.text: Take care. I don't feel like smiling right now.

after5_co_teacher_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_co_teacher_1.text: *She closes the attendance book.* Another teacher is handling today's event.

after5_co_teacher_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_co_teacher_2.text: Do not come to the staff room today.

after5_co_nurse_1.name: School Nurse
after5_co_nurse_1.text: *She puts the chart in a drawer.* This is where our counseling ends.

after5_co_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
after5_co_nurse_2.text: If you're hurt, see another teacher today. I can't help you.

after5_co_tempter_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_tempter_seo_1.text: *She pockets the rooftop keychain.* I was the one who approached you first yesterday.

after5_co_tempter_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_co_tempter_seo_2.text: Even so, I won't ask you to stay today.

after5_co_tempter_yuna_1.name: Yuna
after5_co_tempter_yuna_1.text: *The annex photo is still on her lock screen.* I called you.

after5_co_tempter_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after5_co_tempter_yuna_2.text: Don't go after them now. That's all I need.

after5_co_tempter_dain_1.name: Dain
after5_co_tempter_dain_1.text: *She presses the tape on her knee.* I was the one who told you to stay yesterday.

after5_co_tempter_dain_2.name: Dain
after5_co_tempter_dain_2.text: I won't be the one to call you over first today.

after5_normal_start.name: {name}
after5_normal_start.text: *The event is winding down. In the hall, I run into the two people I didn't choose.*

after5_farewell_seo_high_1.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_high_1.text: *Seoyeon takes the note from our first day out of her clipboard and smooths its folded corner with her thumb.* I still have this.

after5_farewell_seo_high_2.name: Seoyeon
after5_farewell_seo_high_2.text: I know who you chose. But I will not pretend the time I liked you never happened.

after5_farewell_yuna_high_1.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_high_1.text: *Yuna writes today’s date on the back of a bookmark and hands it to me.* You read it through the last page.

after5_farewell_yuna_high_2.name: Yuna
after5_farewell_yuna_high_2.text: Do not be late for the person you chose. I am not erasing the lines where I liked you, either.

after5_farewell_dain_high_1.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_high_1.text: *Dain bounces the volleyball once, catches it, and sets it outside the court line.* I know who you chose.

after5_farewell_dain_high_2.name: Dain
after5_farewell_dain_high_2.text: But I will not act like liking you never happened. Treat her well. Or I really will get mad.

after5_hidden_teacher_high.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_high.text: *She checks the blank comment box in critique copy 04, then closes the envelope.* Tell me on Monday where you stopped. Do not pick only the nice parts.

after5_hidden_teacher_mid.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_mid.text: *She checks the number on critique copy 04.* Mark only how far you read. We will review the rest with the literature club.

after5_hidden_teacher_low.name: Homeroom Teacher
after5_hidden_teacher_low.text: *She puts the manuscript envelope into the file.* You will receive the critique during the scheduled club time. Finish the event first today.

after5_hidden_nurse_high.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_high.text: *She places the counseling confirmation and first-aid card side by side.* Next time it gets heavy, do not endure it alone. Contact people in the order you decided.

after5_hidden_nurse_mid.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_mid.text: *She points to the counseling QR code on the back of the first-aid card.* Book here if you need it. You do not need to invent a reason.

after5_hidden_nurse_low.name: School Nurse
after5_hidden_nurse_low.text: *She files the counseling record and closes the appointment book.* Schedule the next session through the proper process. We are done recording today.

after5_last_chance_seo_postponed.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_postponed.text: Finish what you left on the rooftop yesterday.

after5_last_chance_seo_tentative.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_tentative.text: We did not make another plan yesterday. Still, you came first today.

after5_last_chance_seo_distance.name: Seoyeon
after5_last_chance_seo_distance.text: Yesterday, we agreed to stop there. Tell me why you came today first.

after5_last_chance_dain_postponed.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_postponed.text: Finish what you could not say yesterday. I want to hear it.

after5_last_chance_dain_tentative.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_tentative.text: We never made the next plan yesterday. You came first today.

after5_last_chance_dain_distance.name: Dain
after5_last_chance_dain_distance.text: We both stopped yesterday. I want to hear why you came back today.

after5_last_chance_yuna_postponed.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_postponed.text: We postponed the ending yesterday. I will hear your answer first today.

after5_last_chance_yuna_tentative.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_tentative.text: I said I would contact you first. But you came today.

after5_last_chance_yuna_distance.name: Yuna
after5_last_chance_yuna_distance.text: Yesterday, we agreed to stop there. I will hear why you came today.

after5_hidden_return_to_park.name: {name}
after5_hidden_return_to_park.text: *After finishing the work, I leave school. Folded festival banners line the road toward the park.*
